description:
ContextForge AI Gateway configuration settings.

Examples:
    >>> from mcpgateway.config import Settings
    >>> s = Settings(basic_auth_user='admin', basic_auth_password='secret')
    >>> s.api_key
    'admin:secret'
    >>> s2 = Settings(transport_type='http')
    >>> s2.validate_transport()  # no error
    >>> s3 = Settings(transport_type='invalid')
    >>> try:
    ...     s3.validate_transport()
    ... except ValueError as e:
    ...     print('error')
    error
    >>> s4 = Settings(database_url='sqlite:///./test.db')
    >>> isinstance(s4.database_settings, dict)
    True
    >>> s5 = Settings()
    >>> s5.app_name
    'ContextForge'
    >>> s5.host in ('0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1')  # Default can be either
    True
    >>> s5.port
    4444
    >>> s5.auth_required
    True
    >>> isinstance(s5.allowed_origins, set)
    True
    >>> s6 = Settings(log_detailed_skip_endpoints=["/metrics", "/health"])
    >>> s6.log_detailed_skip_endpoints
    ['/metrics', '/health']
    >>> s7 = Settings(log_detailed_sample_rate=0.5)
    >>> s7.log_detailed_sample_rate
    0.5
    >>> s8 = Settings(log_resolve_user_identity=True)
    >>> s8.log_resolve_user_identity
    True
    >>> s9 = Settings()
    >>> s9.log_detailed_skip_endpoints
    []
    >>> s9.log_detailed_sample_rate
    1.0
    >>> s9.log_resolve_user_identity
    False

Disabled by default because free-form fields may contain PII, tool argument values, or exception content. cpex_control_telemetry_emit_reason.title: Cpex Control Telemetry Emit Reason

cpex_control_telemetry_enabled.description: Emit structured CPEX control-execution telemetry on tool invocations. Disabled by default — each traced tool call creates up to 1 summary + CPEX_CONTROL_TELEMETRY_MAX_RESULTS result DB spans. Enable only after reviewing storage and cardinality implications. cpex_control_telemetry_max_results.title: Cpex Control Telemetry Max Results

uaid_max_length.description: Maximum allowed length for UAID strings. Used to prevent DoS attacks via excessively long UAID parsing. Must not exceed database column limit (2048). Default 2048 matches database capacity. Operators can reduce for stricter DoS protection but cannot exceed database schema limit.
uaid_max_length.title: Uaid Max Length

uaid_require_allowlist_on_startup.description: Fail-fast mode: abort gateway startup if A2A enabled but UAID allowlist not configured. Default false = ERROR log only (non-blocking). Set true for stricter security posture in production.
uaid_require_allowlist_on_startup.title: Uaid Require Allowlist On Startup

ui_base_url.description: Trusted deployment base or full frontend root ending in /app for browser-facing UI links. Falls back to APP_DOMAIN plus APP_ROOT_PATH when unset.
ui_base_url.title: Ui Base Url

use_postgresdb_percentiles.description: Use database-native percentile functions (percentile_cont) for performance metrics. When enabled, PostgreSQL uses native SQL percentile calculations (5-10x faster). When disabled or using SQLite, falls back to Python-based percentile calculations. Recommended: true for PostgreSQL, auto-detected for SQLite.
use_postgresdb_percentiles.title: Use Postgresdb Percentiles

validate_token_environment.description: Reject tokens with mismatched environment claim (tokens without env claim are allowed)
validate_token_environment.title: Validate Token Environment

validation_max_json_depth.description: Maximum allowed JSON nesting depth for tool/resource schemas. Increased from 10 to 30 for compatibility with deeply nested schemas like Notion MCP (issue #1542). Override with VALIDATION_MAX_JSON_DEPTH environment variable. Minimum: 1, Maximum: 100
validation_max_json_depth.title: Validation Max Json Depth

validation_max_tag_length.description: Maximum length for individual tags. Tags longer than this will be rejected. Default: 100 characters. Supports system-generated tags, hashes, and namespaced identifiers. Override with VALIDATION_MAX_TAG_LENGTH environment variable. Minimum: 10, Maximum: 255 (database constraint)
validation_max_tag_length.title: Validation Max Tag Length

validation_middleware_enabled.description: Deprecated. Enable validation middleware for all requests
validation_middleware_enabled.title: Validation Middleware Enabled

validation_min_tag_length.description: Minimum length for individual tags. Tags shorter than this will be rejected. Override with VALIDATION_MIN_TAG_LENGTH environment variable. Minimum: 1, Maximum: 10
validation_min_tag_length.title: Validation Min Tag Length

validation_strict.description: Strict validation mode - reject on violations
validation_strict.title: Validation Strict

vault_kv_path_prefix.description: Path prefix within KV mount. Full path: {mount}/data/{prefix}/{team_id}/{server_id}/{email}
vault_kv_path_prefix.title: Vault Kv Path Prefix

vault_namespace.description: Vault namespace (Enterprise only; leave empty for CE).
vault_namespace.title: Vault Namespace

vault_tls_verify.description: Verify Vault TLS certificate (set false for local dev only).
vault_tls_verify.title: Vault Tls Verify

vault_token.description: Vault authentication token (Phase 1: static token; Phase 2: AppRole). Required when oauth_token_backend='vault'.
vault_token.title: Vault Token

vault_token_cache_enabled.description: Enable in-memory token cache to reduce Vault API calls. Reduces read latency from ~25ms to ~0.5ms on cache hits.
vault_token_cache_enabled.title: Vault Token Cache Enabled

vault_token_cache_max_size.description: Max cached entries before LRU eviction. Each entry ≈ 1 KB → 10 MB at default size.
vault_token_cache_max_size.title: Vault Token Cache Max Size

vault_token_cache_ttl.description: Cache TTL in seconds. Tokens may be stale within this window if rotated externally.
vault_token_cache_ttl.title: Vault Token Cache Ttl

well_known_robots_txt.default:
User-agent: *
Disallow: /

well_known_robots_txt.title: Well Known Robots Txt

yield_batch_size.description: Number of rows fetched per batch when streaming hourly metric data from the database. Used to limit memory usage during aggregation and percentile calculations. Smaller values reduce memory footprint but increase DB round-trips; larger values improve throughput at the cost of higher memory usage.
yield_batch_size.title: Yield Batch Size
